SELECT ST.OWNRKY , ST.WAREKY , ST.AREAKY , ST.ZONEKY , ST.LOCAKY , ST.TRNUID , SM.SKUG05 , SM.EANCOD
, ST.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SM.ASKU01 /* 유통기한 관리여부 */ , '['|| ST.LOTA10 ||']' || (SELECT CMCDV.CDESC1 FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDV.CMCDKY = 'LOTA10' AND CMCDV.CMCDVL = ST.LOTA10) AS LOTA10 , TO_CHAR((TO_DATE(ST.LOTA11, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS LOTA11 /* 제조일자 */ , TO_CHAR((TO_DATE(ST.LOTA12, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')), 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS LOTA12 /* 입고일자 */ , CASE WHEN ST.LOTA13 = ' ' THEN '9999.12.31' ELSE TO_CHAR((TO_DATE(ST.LOTA13, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')), 'YYYY.MM.DD') END AS LOTA13 /* 유통기한 */ , CASE WHEN SM.ASKU01 = 'N' THEN '9999.12.31'
END AS SHP_LIMIT /* 출고제한일 */ , SUM(ST.QTSIWH) AS QTSIWH , SUM(ST.QTSIWH - GREATEST(ST.QTSALO,ST.QTSPMO) - ST.QTSBLK) AS USEQTY , SUM(ST.QTSALO) AS QTSALO , SUM(ST.QTSPMO) - SUM(ST.QTSALO) AS QTSPMV , SUM(ST.QTSPMO) AS QTSPMO , SUM(ST.QTSPMI) AS QTSPMI , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , SW.PLOCOV , NVL((SELECT QTPUOM FROM MEASI WHERE WAREKY = ST.WAREKY AND MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND UOMKEY = 'BOX'), 1) AS BXIPSU FROM STKKY ST INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = ST.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = ST.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.OWNRKY = ST.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = ST.SKUKEY AND SW.WAREKY = ST.WAREKY
WHERE 1 = 1 AND NOT (ST.QTSIWH = 0 AND ST.QTSPMI = 0) AND ST.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY#
AND ST.LOCAKY = #LOCAKY#
AND (ST.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR SM.EANCOD = #BARCOD# OR SM.GTINCD = #BARCOD# OR SM.ASKU05 = #BARCOD#)
AND ST.TRNUID = #TRNUID#
GROUP BY ST.OWNRKY , ST.WAREKY , ST.AREAKY , ST.ZONEKY , ST.LOCAKY , ST.TRNUID , SM.SKUG05 , SM.EANCOD
, ST.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SM.ASKU01 , ST.LOTA09 , ST.LOTA10 , ST.LOTA11 , ST.LOTA12 , ST.LOTA13 , SM.DUOMKY , SW.MEASKY , SM.QTYMON , SM.QTYSTD , SW.PLOCOV ORDER BY ST.LOCAKY

SELECT SW.OWNRKY AS OWNRKY --Owner key , SW.WAREKY AS WAREKY --창고코드 , SW.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY --SKU ID , SM.DESC01 AS DESC01 --SKU 명 , SM.ASKU01 AS ASKU01 --유통기한 관리여부 , SM.SKUG05 AS SKUG05 --SELLER ID , SL.NAME01 AS SELLERNM --SELLER명 , SM.EANCOD AS EANCOD --상품바코드 , SM.ABCANV AS ABCANV --EFM보관등급 1~5 = S~D , SW.PLOCOV AS FIXLOC --FIX LOCATION , TRIM(SW.ABCANV) AS SWABCANV --WMS 보관등급 , LM.AREAKY AS AREAKY --층구분 , LM.TKZONE AS ZONEKY --ZONE , LM.LOCAKY FROM SKUMA SM INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.OWNRKY = SM.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = SM.SKUKEY INNER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = SW.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = SW.PLOCOV INNER JOIN BZPTN SL On SL.OWNRKY = SW.OWNRKY AND SL.PTNRKY = SM.SKUG05 AND SL.PTNRTY = 'VD' WHERE 1=1 AND SW.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER# AND SW.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY#
AND SW.PLOCOV = #FIXLOC#
AND SW.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY# OR SM.EANCOD = #SKUKEY#

SELECT LA.LOCAKY , LA.ZONEKY FROM LOCMA LA INNER JOIN AREMA AA ON AA.WAREKy = LA.WAREKY AND AA.AREAKY = LA.AREAKY WHERE 0 = NVL((SELECT SUM(X.QTSIWH + X.QTSPMI) FROM STKKY X WHERE X.WAREKY = LA.WAREKY AND X.LOCAKY = LA.LOCAKY),0) AND LA.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY#
AND AA.LSTRTY = #LSTRTY#
AND LA.ZONEKY LIKE '%'||#ZONEKY#||'%'
AND LA.LOCATY = #LOCATY#
AND ROWNUM <=30
ORDER BY LA.LOCAKY
SELECT LSTRTY AS VALUE_COL , LSTTNM AS TEXT_COL FROM SHPTH WHERE WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY#
SELECT CMCDVL AS VALUE_COL , CDESC1 AS TEXT_COL FROM CMCDV WHERE CMCDKY ='LOCATY'

SELECT SM.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SM.EANCOD , SM.SKUG05 , SM.DUOMKY , AI.QTPUOM , BN.NAME01 , SUM(AI.QTYASN) AS QTYASN , SUM(AI.QTYRCV) AS QTYRCV FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN BZPTN BN ON BN.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND BN.PTNRKY = SM.SKUG05 AND BN.PTNRTY = 'VD' WHERE AH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AH.ASNTTY = '131'
AND AH.ASNDAT = #ASNDAT#
AND (AI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR SM.EANCOD = #BARCOD# OR SM.GTINCD = #BARCOD# OR SM.ASKU05 = #BARCOD#)
GROUP BY SM.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SM.EANCOD , SM.SKUG05 , SM.DUOMKY , AI.QTPUOM , BN.NAME01 ORDER BY SM.SKUG05
